# S — World and Life / six product offices

The product field is an **Episteme record family**, not a fifth publication register and not a software appendix. [S — World and Life](S-World-and-Life.md) holds the governing relation: Subjective Immediacy is the knower, Objective Internality the means, World the known, and Life / Mind the whole. The six child records disclose six aspects of that mediating field.

Paradigm is not a seventh product. It names a relatively durable organisation of Objective Internality: the lived pattern through which a Life encounters a World as intelligible, actionable and consequential. The six products make offices of one deliberately constructed paradigm increasingly explicit while remaining answerable to the wider Life/World relation.

## Reading rule

Read each S child as a **whole product subject**, not as one subposition in a lens. Its paired lenses disclose the whole subject; its internal `P0–P5` constitution is a different sixfold. The stable M37–M42 filenames retain the prior technical subjects as historical aliases, while the movement bodies and [§5 canonical alignment](../../06-objective-internality/P1-CANONICAL-ALIGNMENT.md) govern the current linear argument.

The inherited technical developments remain live where their operations belong. Model mathematics, apoha/selection, J-Space and preference are chiefly retained under Actuation; Bimba/source continuity under Central; returned transformation and Power under Factory; material actuality under Workcell; nested/co-internal relation under QL. The six research vectors remain experiments testing the field, not six metaphysical offices.

## Return

The six movements do not end in a seventh product. They return through S into Life and World and then into [M43 — From Theory to Vocation](../../07-instrument-returns/movements/43-s50-p0-theory-vocation-compassion.md), where the achieved paradigm must remain answerable to source, Other, material consequence and the formal limit.
